title: Rosalind and the Landfall
author: Lena Villalobos
blurb: Mirabel Quintana, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
